zh.title: 拓竹 A1 打印桌

en.title: Bambu Lab A1 Print Desk
en.description: An unofficial Three.js A1 study at work. Orbit around it as a ripple vase grows layer by layer.

zh.title: chladni
zh.description: 驻波方程解出来的节线。一万两千颗沙子自己找到不振动的地方待着。

en.title: chladni
en.description: Nodal lines solved out of the standing wave equation. Twelve thousand grains of sand find the spots that don't vibrate and settle there.

zh.title: flow field
zh.description: 几千个粒子跟着噪声场漂，拖尾积成流线。鼠标能把它们推开。

en.title: flow field
en.description: A few thousand particles drift along a noise field, trails piling up into streamlines. Your cursor pushes them around.

zh.title: 重力书法
zh.description: 写下的墨迹不肯待在纸上。松手后整笔坠落，重力和风说了算。

en.title: Gravity Calligraphy
en.description: Ink refuses to stay on the page. Release a stroke and let gravity and wind take over.

zh.title: pixel sort

en.title: pixel sort
en.description: Pixels sorted by luminance into smeared glitch streaks. Drop in your own image, download the result.

zh.title: 山海异兽图鉴
zh.description: 翻一页，遇见一只没有被古书记下的异兽。

en.title: Mythical Beast Field Guide
en.description: Turn a page and meet a beast no ancient book remembered.
